arStrings.szText: Rupture
Weapon Mastery Skill: Thrust your weapon into open wounds on the enemy, dealing heavy damage if it is bleeding.
{c_important}Rupture{/c} now causes an explosion when you rip your weapon out, dealing {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEA_EXPLOSION_BLEEDING}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds.
Gore

{c_important}Rupture{/c} now creates a blood pool when you rip your weapon out, inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEB_AOE_BLEED}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds. You and your Allies gain {c_number}[SF_23 * 100]%{/c} increased Attack Speed while standing in the blood pool.
Blood Pool

Casting {c_important}Rupture{/c} Summons {c_number}[SF_47]{/c} Ancients that skewer your target for {c_number}{payload:INITIAL_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and then performing a rip attack that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_RIP_DAMAGE}{/c} as direct damage instead of Bleeding.
All For One
{c_important}Rupture's{/c} Size is increased by {c_number}[{SF_52}*100|%|]{/c}.
Size Bonus
{c_important}Rupture{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_43}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. Each subsequent enemy Hit reduces this bonus by {c_number}[{SF_44}*100|%|]{/c}.
Damage Bonus
Ripping your weapon out of enemies reduces {c_important}Rupture's{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}{SF_50}{/c} second.
Cooldown Reduction
Heal for {c_number}[{SF_55}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life on Hit.
Healing
(NYI) You teleport to them before you {c_important}Rupture{/c}
(NYI) Upgrade 2
